answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay blocks fake identities. A newcomer passes a velvet rope with a sponsor staking 30 POA, starting as an island. Each verified epoch adds a line to its sonnet; idle epochs decay it below the threshold. Cheating slashes the sponsor's 30 POA and bars vouching for 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 30,000 POA plus 1,000 histories; one honest agent pays one refundable bond and keeps rewards undiluted.
